# GovInfo

> GovInfo is the Government Publishing Office's (GPO) official digital repository providing free, authenticated access to legislative, executive, and judicial branch documents.

GovInfo serves as the successor to FDsys and is the authoritative source for federal government information including Congressional publications, the Federal Register, Code of Federal Regulations, and agency submissions. The platform emphasizes digital preservation, public access, and authenticated document delivery.

## Key Topics

- GovInfo
- Government Printing Office (GPO)
- Congress
- Federal Register

## Getting Started

- [About Us](https://govinfo.gov/about): Overview of GovInfo service, GPO mission, and transition from FDsys
- [U.S. Government Information](https://govinfo.gov/about/us-gov-info): Overview of legislative, executive, and judicial branches of federal government
- [Browse by A to Z](https://govinfo.gov/browse-a-z): Alphabetical index for discovering government documents and congressional publications

## Developer Resources & APIs

- [Developer Hub](https://govinfo.gov/developers): API documentation, bulk data access, and developer resources for GovInfo
- [System Design and Documentation](https://govinfo.gov/developers/system-design): Technical specifications and architecture documentation for GovInfo platform
- [RSS Feeds](https://govinfo.gov/feeds): RSS feed subscriptions for GovInfo collections and recent document updates
- [Sitemaps](https://govinfo.gov/sitemaps): XML sitemaps for web crawling and content harvesting from GovInfo

## Content & Preservation

- [Digital Preservation](https://govinfo.gov/about/digital-preservation): Digital stewardship practices, ISO 16363 certification, and archival standards
- [Agency Submission](https://govinfo.gov/about/agency-submission): Instructions for federal agencies to submit content for preservation and access

## Policies & Reference

- [Policies](https://govinfo.gov/about/policies): Digital dissemination, preservation, copyright, privacy, and accessibility policies
- [Authentication](https://govinfo.gov/about/authentication): Guide to digital signatures and PDF document authentication verification

## Optional

- [History](https://govinfo.gov/about/history): Timeline of GovInfo and GPO's online government information access evolution
